title: Dangerous function mysql_query (php) — review required
description: The php call mysql_query evaluates code, invokes by name, or uses a removed database extension. Untrusted input becomes execution or failure. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer removes it via PDO with bindings.
remediation: Remove or use PDO with bindings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any mysql_query call matches.
